description: This file defines a React functional component called 'Starfield' that renders a dynamic, multi-layered starfield animation using a HTML5 canvas. It manages animation state with React refs for performance, handles resize events to adapt to viewport changes, and draws stars in three layers with different densities, sizes, opacities, and velocities to create a parallax starfield effect.

methods.name: buildStars()
methods.description: Initializes star positions and properties for each layer based on current viewport size and density.

methods.name: makeLayer(count, W, H, params)
methods.description: Generates an array of star objects with randomized positions and properties based on provided parameters.

methods.name: draw(dt)
methods.description: Clears the canvas and draws all star layers with current star positions and properties.

methods.name: drawLayer(ctx, layer, dt, layerSpeedScale, colorHex, W, H)
methods.description: Draws individual stars in a layer, updating their positions and wrapping them around when passing the bottom.

methods.name: hexToRgb(hex)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal color string to an RGB object for use in canvas fill styles.

methods.name: rand(a, b)
methods.description: Generates a random floating-point number between two given bounds.

ctags.name: Starfield
ctags.pattern: /^export default function Starfield({ speed = 1, density = 1, color = '#ffffff' }) {$/

ctags.name: drawLayer
ctags.pattern: /^  function drawLayer(ctx, layer, dt, layerSpeedScale, colorHex, W, H) {$/
ctags.signature: (ctx, layer, dt, layerSpeedScale, colorHex, W, H)

ctags.name: rand
ctags.pattern: /^  function rand(a, b) { return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }$/
